messages.subject: Webinar: Commercial property update – TOGC, SDLT and the new lease code
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Elena,

Join our 90-minute CPD webinar on 23 April covering recent developments in commercial property: TOGC pitfalls on investment sales, SDLT on mixed-use, and the revised Code for Leasing Business Premises. 1.5 CPD hours. Early-bird £95 + VAT.

Book now at centrallawtraining.co.uk/events. Unsubscribe at any time.

Central Law Training
